about.title: A maritime platform for people who choose the water
about.subtitle: Meridian connects owners of yachts and expedition vessels with people looking for a voyage or a scientific expedition — no middlemen, no endless calls.

mission.title: Technology instead of paperwork
mission.description: Booking a vessel used to mean weeks of correspondence and dozens of calls. We built an environment where search, comparison, and booking take minutes — with pricing and availability always up to date.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Price is locked in at the moment of booking and never changes retroactively — for the guest or the owner.

items.title: Verified fleet
items.description: Every vessel and owner is verified before appearing in the catalog.

items.title: Freedom for initiatives
items.description: The platform provides the technical environment for expedition projects but doesn't moderate their content — that stays with the authors.
